definitions: A common overuse injury affecting the iliotibial band, a thick band of fibrous tissue that runs down the outside of the thigh from the hip to the shin.
Characterised by pain on the outside of the knee, particularly during or after activities such as running or cycling.
examples: The runner was diagnosed with iliotibial band syndrome.
Physiotherapy can help manage iliotibial band syndrome.
Preventing iliotibial band syndrome involves proper warm-up.
